title: Way Over Yonder In the Minor Key

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I lived in a place called Okfuskee
And I had a little girl in a holler tree
I said, little girl, it's plain to see
Ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: She said it's hard for me to see
How one little boy got so ugly
I said, yes my lil girlie that might be
But there ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We walked down by the buckeye creek
To see the frog eat the goggle-eye bee
Hear that whistlin whistle to the east
There ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh my little girlie will you let me see
Way over yonder where the wind blows free
Nobody can see in our holler tree
And there ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Way over yonder in the minor key

Way over yonder in the minor key

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Her mama cut a switch from a cherry tree
And laid it for she and me
It stung lots worse than a hive of bees
But there ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Now I have walked a long long ways
And I still look back to my Tanglewood days
I've led lots of girls since then to stray
Sayin' ain't nobody that can sing like me
Ain't nobody that can sing like me
